receipt.public_excerpt: The toxicity problem, for example, is never going to be solved.

evidence_items.explanation: This establishes toxicity as one warning within the retrospective period. Marcus's statement is not evidence that the warning was correct.
The model snapshot reported before publication supports continued factual unreliability. It establishes persistence of one problem, not the universal claim about every earlier warning.
The same research documents improvements. These caution against reading Marcus as saying there was no progress, but improvement alone does not establish a general solution.

unresolved_gaps: No complete, bounded inventory of the preceding five years of warnings was established.
No common criterion determines when each heterogeneous problem is properly solved.
Persistent hallucinations do not establish that every other warned-about problem remained unresolved.
The historical starting point and the stronger architectural meaning of inherently remain unspecified.
